title: Technology Sector Update for 01/07/2019: FIVN,MU,INTC,MSI,QTRH,AAPL

Technology stocks firmed in late trading, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 were adding nearly 1.1% in value this afternoon while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was rising almost 2.4%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) Five9 ( FIVN ) rose almost 12% during Monday's session after the cloud software firm was raised to Overweight from Equalweight in an upgrade at Morgan Stanley, which also increased its price target for the company's stock by $17 to $54 a share.
In other sector news:
(+) Micron Technology ( MU ) climbed more than 5% at one point on Monday after the specialty chipmaker said it will be the primary memory provider for fifth-generation EyeQ5 system-on-chip-based EPM5 platform by Intel's ( INTC ) Mobileye unit for fully autonomous vehicles expected to be on the road next year.
(+) Motorola Solutions ( MSI ) Monday was hanging onto a 0.5% rise in recent trading after the networking equipment company said it acquired vehicle-location video company VaaS International Holdings for $445 million in cash and stock in a move intended to widen its command center software offerings.
(-) Quarterhill's ( QTRH ) declined almost 4% on Monday after a district court judge in California late Friday gave the Canadian technology portfolio company's WiLAN unit the choice of either accepting a reduced $10 million damage award or to begin a new trial to determine Apple's liability in its patent fight with Quarterhill.
